name: BattleTarget_SelectRandomPosition
domain: Builds an encoded target-position list from one side of the battle turn order and returns a uniformly selected entry, optionally rejecting vacant and defeated units.
expressed: the normal-list path with vacant-unit and zero-HP rejection
the mirrored-list path with vacant-unit rejection
the empty-list zero result and uniform 16-bit random selection
bounded_checks: a direct typed-array loop emitted 198 bytes with 116 wrong instructions and unnecessary high-register saves
pointer-walking both lists recovered the exact 16-byte frame and r4/r5/r6/r7 register family, reducing the aligned residual to 90 wrong instructions
a hybrid pointer/indexed form regressed to 107 wrong instructions
the remaining residual is broad loop allocation and literal-pool placement, so no permutation search or permanent classification is justified
notes: All six edition starts are proved, but this owner is not a constant-only all-six core: the normalized reference cores retain two to seven regional bytes of difference.
Retained assembly remains authoritative and this draft claims zero DONE bytes.
